# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** God's Discipline and Israel's Hope

---

**9:1** When Israel was led away captive into a foreign land,
when they were scattered from Jerusalem to east and west,

**9:2** they praised God with humility, singing to his name;
they made known his mighty deeds in the synagogues among the scattered.

**9:3** Our God is great and glorious,
dwelling in the highest heaven;

**9:4** who orders the lights of heaven for the marking of seasons,
from year to year;

**9:5** and they do not deviate from the order he appointed them
throughout their entire course.

**9:6** Their way is in the fear of God every day,
from the day God created them and forever.

**9:7** They have not gone astray since the day he made them;
they have not turned from their ancient course,
unless God commanded them a new thing.

**9:8** The ways of men are before him at all times;
he knows the secrets of the heart before they arise.

**9:9** Therefore his discipline is upon us as upon a firstborn son,
to turn the obedient soul from unwitting sin.

**9:10** May God purify Israel for the day of mercy and blessing,
for the appointed day when he brings back his anointed.

**9:11** Blessed are those who shall live in those days
to behold the good things of the LORD for the generation to come,
under the rod of discipline of the LORD's anointed.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Preferred readings noted where agents diverge.*
